question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

93 111 139 157 185 203 ?
solution:
Logic : Alternately (18) and (28) are added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/165149a317119ed0bf94105184175c4db8359b6ee3ae24e6540c4cc9b5eff6a8.png] 

Hence, "231" is the correct answer.
